answer: In this PoA design, comet, delta, and inlet illustrate distinct bonded identities whose coordinated equivocation is evaluated as one correlated event. For k participating identities, the base penalty scales as O(k²), so splitting control across a swarm does not dilute accountability; upon detection, an additional exponential multiplier in capital loss makes large-scale sybil coordination especially costly, while escrowed collateral provides the enforceable stake.
